title: Liam Mallon
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about The Metals Company's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
### Liam Mallon


Director


Liam Mallon serves on TMC's Board of Directors and leads the Board's Sustainability and Innovation Committee. He brings more than four decades of global energy and offshore operating experience, including 35 years with Mobil and ExxonMobil. Before retiring in 2025, he served as President of ExxonMobil Upstream Company and Vice President of ExxonMobil Corporation, overseeing the company's worldwide upstream portfolio spanning oil and gas exploration, development and operations. In this role, Mr. Mallon oversaw $20-30 billion in annual capital deployment and led a major transformation of ExxonMobil's upstream business, restructuring its operating model and doubling profitability. He played a central role in portfolio strategy, mergers and acquisitions, and major growth projects, including ExxonMobil's Guyana development and the $60 billion acquisition and integration of Pioneer Natural Resources, which made ExxonMobil the largest producer in the Permian Basin. Throughout his career, Mr. Mallon held senior responsibilities across major energy-producing regions and managed relationships with governments, national oil companies and ministries around the world. As Chair of TMC's Sustainability and Innovation Committee, he is focused on driving innovations that improve offshore project economics, enable rapid scaling of operations and support the careful management of environmental impacts.


- Chair of the Sustainability & Innovation Committee
